title: Why AI Won’t Replace You (But People Using AI Will)
description:
The biggest mistake business owners make with AI is asking it to think for them. If you treat AI like a magic button to solve your problems, you’re going to end up with generic results that don’t convert.

In this video, I talk about how to use AI-assisted automation to actually speed up your sales and marketing without losing your brand's voice. We aren't looking for robots to take over; we are looking for systems that give you an edge over your competitors. I’m breaking down the difference between generic automation and the smarter systems we build at Kodara to help you scale from operator to owner.

Comment “Scale with AI” if you want to scale your business 🔗


#LucasTyson #ArtificialIntelligence #BusinessAutomation #SalesSystems #PerformanceMarketing #aibusiness #businessgrowth #realestate #realwaystomakemoneyfromhome
transcript: I'm not asking it to think for me. I'm asking it to teach me things that I don't know or help me solve problems that I otherwise wouldn't be able to solve reasonably. >> The problem I see with most business owners now is that they're using AI to replace themselves in all of these menial tasks. Things like answering emails, replying to social media comments, maybe filling out, you know, forms and invoices. All these annoying things that no one really wants to spend their time to make. That's fine. However, like he said in that clip, the real people who are winning, the best way to make use of this revolutionary technology is to actually use it to extend the thinking that you're already doing. So, for example, if you're a doctor who obviously gets paid a very high amount in your own private practice to see patients, rather than just using AI to automate, you know, your billing or your services, why not use AI to actually help patients who are maybe freaked out about, you know, having to go to a doctor, having to invest all this money, why don't you use AI to help warm them up and educate them through the process that you're going to take them through? Maybe you help people with, you know, their functional health, you help them heal their gut issues. Why don't you have an AI that could actually educate them on why you're recommending the solution that you're recommending and then helps them stay accountable to that treatment plan. You're doing the exact same thing that you normally would. You're still working with client at a high level, but now rather than just using AI as this low-level, you know, kind of VA employee, now you're actually using it to extend your thinking. The real value here is that your thinking is the thing that clients pay for. It's really the lifeblood of any expertise and any knowledge-based service business. So again, the experts who are winning now are not just delegating all of their thinking to AI, they're using it to extend the thinking that is obviously the thing that their customers and clients are paying them for.
